candidates.issues: Very clean recipe, and every divided ingredient is accounted for. The only minor gap is that it gives no tip for keeping pancakes warm between batches.

The ingredient list has a typo ('1 egg egg'). The low ricotta and single egg make the pancakes less rich and less ricotta-forward. There is no lemon juice in the batter, and the recipe is small with no stated yield.
The compote calls for 'a squeeze of the lemon juice', so the lemon juice split is vague. The separated-egg method works, but there is no yield or warming tip.
Thorough: it accounts for all divided amounts, rests the batter, gives a warm-oven temperature, and states the yield and servings. Essentially no flaws.
Solid and well balanced, with baking soda paired with lemon juice. It uses every ingredient. It is slightly verbose and gives no warming tip.
The cornstarch slurry uses an unlisted extra 1 tsp of water. 'Plus more' butter and the optional extra lemon zest are unquantified. The compote has no lemon, and there is no yield.
